sources.observation: The four peaked copper roofs flank a pale western cap and a green crossing dome. Aisle and nave roofs sit at separate heights.
The rounded east choir has warm sandstone courses and a visible ring of short gallery columns below the eaves.

limitations: The plan and roof datums follow the mapped parts. Exterior relief, stone patterns and wrought decoration are approximated using reusable materials and authored trim.
The model covers the exterior, attached chapels, and the depth of the east gallery. Doors and windows are modeled surface detail.
The west forecourt elevation uses 15th-level Terrarium samples. The exterior terrain around the foundation is approximate.
